verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is an iOS SSH/Mosh terminal client with VS Code-for-web connectivity. Assigning issues to an AI coding agent and getting back pull requests belongs to code-hosting or coding-agent platforms, so this story is a category error for a terminal emulator. Nothing in the evidence shows Blink shipping any issue-to-PR agent capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can assign an issue to an AI coding agent and receive a ready-to-review pull request
